title: ChatModerationResult
description: chat.moderation-result@1: what POST /internal/chat/moderation (chat.moderation.write) answers. 200 with the ids a delete action removed (empty when nothing matched), or with the rows another action changed and the id it inserted. A refusal is chat.ingress-ack@1's error: 400 a body Chat refuses, 409 a key reused with another body, 503 Chat or its delivery unavailable (retry with the same key).

id.description: The inserted row (a log entry, a hidden relay identity), else null.
